title: Chat word filter
description: One language's word list for the versus chat filter (GH-1417 S2, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-16-versus-chat-safety-design.md section 3.3). The file is data/chat/filter.<lang>.json and is registered in @lions/data's `chatFilters`. Every entry is a plain word or phrase, NEVER a pattern: the app matches whole words (and, for a long `hide` entry not in `whole_word`, a word that contains it), after its own normalisation (case, NFKC, marks, zero-width, look-alikes, repeated letters, spaced-out letters). A `hide` entry hides the whole line, whatever the player's settings; a `mask` entry replaces only the word with ***, and Settings can turn that tier off. `allow` names innocent words that contain a long `hide` entry. The upstream list is kept pristine at `source.file` (under data/chat/) and `pnpm validate:data` checks that hide, mask and dropped, minus in_house, are exactly its entries. Cross-file rules are in tools/validate_chat_filters.mjs.

lang.description: A UI language id, as in packages/app/src/i18n/locales.ts. Also the filename.

review.description: Who sorted the upstream list into tiers. `none`: nobody yet, so `hide` must be empty and every entry sits in `mask` or `dropped` (the lead's ruling for the launch languages until a native reader has reviewed them).

file.description: The pristine upstream file, relative to data/chat/.

licence.description: Only a licence the lead ruled on (D3): an attribution-only open licence with redistribution rights recorded in data/chat/LICENSES.md.

whole_word.description: Optional. `hide` entries of SUBSTRING_MIN (6, packages/app/src/ui/chat-filter.ts) or more letters that match whole words only, as a shorter entry does, never inside a longer word. For the plural of a short entry: 'x' + 's' would otherwise move into the inside-a-word tier its singular was never in, and hide innocent names that hold it. Each is a `hide` entry (tools/validate_chat_filters.mjs).

dropped.description: Upstream entries removed on review (an ordinary word in an RTS chat). Kept so that every upstream entry is accounted for.

in_house.description: Entries of our own, not in the upstream list. Every one is also in hide or mask.

entry.description: A plain word or phrase: no pattern characters (* ? + ( ) [ ] { } | \ ^ $ .), no leading, trailing or doubled space.
